run_challenge_eval: run the NeurIPS challenge evaluation script with a model name and NPZ results file to compute success rate
run_is_successful: run the is_successful function to check if a predicted energy is within threshold of the DFT energy
run_compute_valid_ml_success: run compute_valid_ml_success to calculate validated ML success rates by comparing ML energies against DFT ground truth
run_get_dft_data: run get_dft_data to organize target mappings into a nested dictionary of system IDs and config IDs with DFT energies
run_process_ml_data: run process_ml_data to parse an NPZ prediction file and map ML energies to system and config IDs
